payload.objective: Submit Phase 2 R26 Practicum & Basic Science Workspace report and request Phase 3 Task Dispatch.
payload.explicit_request: Phase 2 Practicum & Basic Science Workspace is complete with modular decomposition and 163 tests passing. Please evaluate and issue TASK_DISPATCH for Phase 3 (Virtual Lab 2021 & Statutory Prints).

task_report.summary: Basic Science Practicum view decomposed and integrated into workspace shell; Table 2.2 debounced autosave restored; lesson plan row deletion reconciled; 163 tests passing.

payload.reason: Phase 2 is accepted as complete. The report demonstrates that the 7,366-line Basic Science legacy workspace was decomposed rather than copied, mounted through the mandated workspace architecture, and that the identified Table 2.2 autosave and lesson-plan deletion gaps were reconciled. The reported 163-test, 960-assertion regression suite also remains clean. Phase 3 is therefore authorized as the next reconciliation stage. Phase 3 must preserve the same architectural discipline: print views must use <x-layouts.report-layout>, reusable UI must use existing <x-ui.*> components, and the legacy lab-batch modal must be adapted rather than blindly copied. The practical print set and classroom/tutor reports should be restored based on verified legacy behavior while retaining CampusLynk's existing reporting conventions. Route harmonization must also distinguish genuinely missing routes from endpoints already replaced by modern CampusLynk services or routes. The intentionally deferred M8.3 mobile virtual lab must remain outside this phase.
